prompt: If the person who played the joker in "The Dark Knight" (2008) had children, how old will they be on the films 50th anniversary?
answer: Heath Ledger had one child, his daughter Matilda Rose Ledger, born October 28, 2005. *The Dark Knight* was released in 2008, so its 50th anniversary will be in 2058. Matilda will be **52 years old** then, turning 53 in October 2058.
